title: Who reviews changes to the gate and the release script?
detail: Beside protecting main (the conductor's item): any agent's push can change admin/build/validate.js, the workflow, or admin/build/tag_release.sh, which since v0.1.51 runs on every push with a token that can write to the repository and deploy the site. Today the only check is security@'s review, twice a day, after the push. Every ABP in content/abp/ lists this as a Gap held by a rule.
recommend: Protect main now and decide this on Wednesday with WS-34: a review rule on dev would hold up dev@'s gate work during the sprint, and security@ already reads every commit twice a day.
options: Dinis reviews them before they land (CODEOWNERS and a rule on dev; dev@'s gate work waits for him)
security@ flags them after the fact, as today
protect main only this week and decide this on Wednesday
